title: Move to (V) Inbox, Important and Other
steps: On the fake data, in the Inbox press V on a conversation and choose Other under Places, then press Cmd-Z
Press V again and choose Important, then press Cmd-Z
Open Done (G then E), press V on a conversation and choose Inbox
Check two conversations with X and press V
expected: Step 1 and 2: the toasts say Moved to Other and Moved to Important, the conversation changes tab, and each Cmd-Z puts it back. The Inbox row is not offered while the conversation is in the Inbox. Step 3: the Inbox row is listed first and the toast says Moved to Inbox. Step 4: Important and Other are dimmed with Works on one conversation at a time.
